note: #2779 scenario 9 — a GAP in the OS thermal reading mid-episode. Cool start.

A minute with NO thermal key at all — the OS read came back empty. Omitting the key IS the `None` reading; it is not a missing field to be defaulted. A gap is `time passed, no new information`: the pause must hold.
Readings return, still hot. Same episode — the pause never lifted, so this must not be counted as a second one.

A SECOND gap, two minutes long, and this one runs straight into the recovery below with no hot reading in between to wipe it. That adjacency is the point: if a gap ACCUMULATED toward the resume hold instead of resetting it, the very first cool reading after this frame would satisfy a 60s hold that had never actually been served, and the run would resume on a machine nobody has a reading for.
Genuine recovery. It must take a full, CONTINUOUS resume_hold_ms of cool readings inside THIS frame — none of the gap above counts.
